_note: Routing preferences template. Maps instruction semantic_ids to preferred backend routing. Copy to your copilot or Agent config directory and populate. Default rank-based routing works without this file — this file only adjusts preferences.
_design: Preference, not fact. text_cli_schema.json defines what instructions exist and their available backends. This file defines which backend YOUR Agent prefers. Different Agents can have different preferences.
_when_loaded: Level 2+ (copilot installed). Level 0-1 users do not need this file — default rank routing works.

<semantic_id>.reason: <why this preference, e.g. lower latency or cleaner response format>

global_defaults._rationale: Local first (fastest, no auth), then MCP (structured), then HTTP fallback

tencentmap:geocoder_location.reason: MCP response is already structured, no HTTP auth needed

weather:query.reason: Official endpoint has richer forecast data
